usage: Muscle mass is a non-count noun and is always used to refer to the total amount of muscle in the body.
You can talk about increasing or decreasing muscle mass through exercise or diet.
When describing muscle mass, it is common to use adjectives such as high, low, or large before the noun.
Muscle mass can be the subject or object of a sentence when discussing fitness.
To compare muscle mass, you might use phrases like ‘more muscle mass’ or ‘less muscle mass’.
